resources.string: Please type in your 24-word secret recovery phrase in the correct order.

is a unique set of 24 words, appearing in a precise order. It can be used to gain full control of your funds from any device via any Zcash wallet app. Think of it as the master key to your wallet. It is stored in Zapp’s Advanced Settings.

is the block height (block # in the blockchain) at which your wallet was created. If you ever lose access to your Zapp app and need to recover your funds, providing the block height along with your recovery phrase can significantly speed up the process.
Entering your Wallet Birthday Height helps speed up the restore process.
Wallet Birthday Height is the point in time when your wallet was created.
